alice_customer: Hey team — we're seeing a weird embeddings error in prod after a client update. Calls to /v1/embeddings intermittently return 400 "Invalid embedding shape: expected [N,1536], got [1,1]". Repro steps and payload below.

alice_customer: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"model":"text-embed-3-small", "input":"[\"Here is a test\"]"}'

alice_customer: This came from our frontend where someone wrapped the array as a JSON string. Also seeing elevated token billing spikes.

sara_support: thanks for the report — can you paste full headers and one raw request body as seen on client? Do you also have a server log id?

alice_customer: header snippet: Authorization ok, Content-Type application/json. No gzip. Request-body (raw): {"model":"text-embed-3-small","input":"[\"Here is a test\"]"}

sara_support: ah — that's the problem. you're sending input as a string that contains JSON. The embeddings endpoint expects input to be an array (or scalar) JSON value, not a JSON stringified array. So the server sees a single scalar string and computes a 1-length vector -> shape mismatch when batched with others. Quick fix: send input as an array: ["Here is a test"].

mike_engineer: adding more detail — when input is a stringified array the downstream parser treats it as a single item; some internal batching code then tries to stack resulting vectors with other requests and you end up with shape mismatch. Also stringified input can dramatically increase tokenization cost (we tokenize the literal brackets/quotes). That explains the billing spike.

mike_engineer: repro curl (bad):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"model":"text-embed-3-small","input":"[\"test\"]"}'
```

mike_engineer: repro curl (good):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"model":"text-embed-3-small","input":["test"]}'
```

mike_engineer: Node example (wrong):
``naxios.post(url, { model: 'text-embed-3-small', input: JSON.stringify([text]) }) // don't JSON.stringify
```

mike_engineer: Node example (right):
```
axios.post(url, { model: 'text-embed-3-small', input: [text] })
```

sara_support: can you confirm if any messages still error after changing to array? Also we can add server-side guard to return clearer 422 when input is a JSON stringified array.

alice_customer: changing to array fixed it — all green. Thanks! :tada:

sara_support: closing on our side but creating internal bug to improve error message and docs. filed REDWOOD-INC-3245. ingest-bot: created ticket REDWOOD-INC-3245
